natural_ceiling_judgment: Commander-centered high-power/optimized artifact prison and cast-loop deck, with a potentially cEDH-capable opening; no formal bracket or measured performance certification
protected_identity: Mishra rescues an artifact card after its spell is countered into graveyard before his cast trigger resolves
Possibility Storm can put an original artifact card into the library before Mishra retrieves it
Asymmetrical use of symmetrical counters through Blood Funnel, Nether Void, Chalice, Void Mirror and other locks
Artifact recursion, cost reductions, cast-draw engines and actual protected artifact combo closures

preferred_challenger.hypothesis: Zero-mana artifact and single-use flexible colored mana improve early Mishra UBR access in a 29-land list and enable artifact-cast chains compared with nine-mana repeat lock
preferred_challenger.strongest_counterargument: Gargoyle is a highly Mishra-specific, tutorable and sometimes Welder-cheatable repeatable prison card; Petal is one-shot mana and may lower lock ceiling

critical_rules_cases: Mishra searches same-name cards only after casting artifact spell; the original on the stack is normally not searchable
Blood Funnel trigger above Mishra can counter artifact to graveyard before Mishra search
An opponent can let Mishra trigger resolve before countering the artifact spell
Possibility Storm cast-from-hand trigger can bottom original before Mishra search; free found cast does not itself retrigger Storm
A creature artifact shares both card types during Possibility Storm matching
Void Mirror and Vexing Bauble can counter own free nonartifact protection spells
Mishra's Workshop mana cannot cast the nonartifact commander
Karn outside-game wishboard does not operate under default Commander rules
Karn plus Mycosynth Lattice shuts opposing artifact-turned-land activated mana abilities
Uthros station threshold and Mystic Forge Top zero-cost reducer setup remain conditional
Scrap Trawler/KCI recursion must satisfy actual mana and mana-value rules
contamination_disclosure: Same ChatGPT GPT-6 model family/project exposure as previous authored and reconciliation reviews; latent familiarity cannot be erased.
